hints.title: Position Invariance
hints.text: Every element in nums is distinct, and replacements only change value, never index.

hints.title: Value to Index Mapping
hints.text: Map each number to its index in nums. When replacing old with new, update nums[idx] and reassign the index mapping.

hints.title: O(1) Per Operation
hints.text: Lookup old value position, write new value to that position, delete old from map, and insert new with position.

hints.title: Direct Index Mapping Implementation

complexity.notes: Building position map takes O(n); each replacement takes O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning nums for old value on every operation takes O(n * m) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Map stores current index of all n values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate updates both the array and the index lookup table in constant time per operation.
